turns.content: Draw or describe the connectivity of 6-chloro-9-ethyl-2-methylundeca-3,7-dien-5-ol, marking the substituents, alcohol group, and double bonds. What groups are attached to each potentially stereogenic tetrahedral carbon?
Examine C2 and C9 in that structure. Is either a stereogenic tetrahedral center? Compare its four substituents to justify the classification.
Apply the same substituent test to C5 and C6. Which of these carbons are stereogenic?
Examine the substituents on each carbon of the two double bonds. Does each double bond support E/Z stereochemistry?
Use the independent stereochemical elements to count distinct stereoisomers, treating the two methyl groups at C2 and the two ethyl groups at C9 as identical.
Could a meso form or another molecular symmetry make any complete stereochemical assignments identical? Check whether the count needs to be reduced.
Give the total number of stereoisomers and identify the tetrahedral and alkene elements contributing to it.
